archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Elite Athleticism & Competition Leaderboard)
theme: Dark Mode First (Dark Navy #0B132B / #1C2541, Signal Red #E63946, Crimson Glow #D62828, Crisp Silver #E0E1DD)

typography.heading_font: Barlow Condensed / Oswald / Chivo (Bold, Condensed, Athletic Impact)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono / IBM Plex Mono (for bodyweights, lift numbers, DOTS, total, rankings)

scale.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight

visual_enhancers.card_style: Sharp rectangular borders (max 6px rounded) with 1px border-[#1E305B] and subtle red/navy ambient glow on hover
visual_enhancers.table_style: High-density crisp competition grid with alternating row contrast, hover highlight line, and sticky header bar
visual_enhancers.accent_bars: Vertical signal red indicators on active tab and top-ranked lifter row
visual_enhancers.blur_effect: backdrop-blur-md bg-[#080F20]/80 for fixed navigation and sticky filter headers

component_hierarchy.name: MeetHeader
component_hierarchy.description: Sticky competition top bar with Meet Title, Live Feed Status indicator, Refresh Button, and quick stats badge

component_hierarchy.name: HeroSection
component_hierarchy.description: Dramatic dark navy hero with bold athletic typography, competition countdown/date badge, total nominations count, and Google Sheet sync badge

component_hierarchy.name: DivisionTabs
component_hierarchy.description: Boys vs Girls primary toggle tabs with Signal Red high-contrast active state and lifter count pill badges

component_hierarchy.name: SearchAndFilterBar
component_hierarchy.description: Lifter search input, IPF weight class selector chips, and sort metric selector (Total, Squat, Bench, Deadlift, Bodyweight)

component_hierarchy.name: NominationsTable
component_hierarchy.description: Crisp athletic leaderboard grid showing Rank, Lifter Name, Bodyweight, Nominated Category, Squat, Bench, Deadlift, Total, and DOTS estimation when available

component_hierarchy.name: LifterDetailModal
component_hierarchy.description: Quick view modal on lifter row click showing attempt breakdown card, bodyweight-to-total ratio, and category ranking

component_hierarchy.name: SheetConfigDrawer
component_hierarchy.description: Optional administrative/debug drawer allowing quick updates to Google Sheet URL and column mapping verification

testing_requirements.file_extension: JavaScript (.js) files only. Do NOT use .tsx

instructions_to_main_agent: Use dark mode as primary theme with dark navy backgrounds (#080F20, #101B35) and signal red accents (#E63946).

Implement CSV fetcher for Google Sheet URL: convert '/edit?usp=sharing' or export link to 'pub?output=csv' or 'export?format=csv'. Provide graceful fallback sample data if sheet fetch is blocked by CORS.
Implement flexible header matching for Name, Gender, Bodyweight, Category, Squat, Bench, Deadlift, Total.
Categorize entries into Boys and Girls sections based on Gender/Division column or IPF weight class format.
Filter by IPF weight classes for Boys (53kg, 59kg, 66kg, 74kg, 83kg, 93kg, 105kg, 120kg, 120+kg) and Girls (43kg, 47kg, 52kg, 57kg, 63kg, 69kg, 76kg, 84kg, 84+kg).
Include real-time search box by lifter name and sort buttons for Total, Squat, Bench, Deadlift.
Ensure every interactive element (button, tab, input, modal trigger, row) has a descriptive data-testid attribute.
Add responsive mobile view with scrollable data table and card view option for small viewports.
Provide live sync status badge with manual 'Refresh Feed' trigger and timestamp.
